article.title: Punishment for fraudulently availing any benefit meant for persons with benchmark disabilities.
article.content:
91Punishment for fraudulently availing any benefit meant for persons with benchmark disabilities.

Section 91  ·  Chapter XVI  ·  page 31 of the Act
Whoever, fraudulently avails or attempts to avail any benefit meant for persons with benchmark disabilities, shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years or with fine which may extend to one lakh rupees or with both.
